verdict: partly consistent: the repeated signs recover خيامهم and فيها رشا; the toothed-curve family covers both ʿayn and ghayn.
notes: 70v l.12 has three signs in تبع, not four: one upright b-form (tāʾ), the doubled horizontal of bāʾ and the toothed curve. Line 13 resolves خيامهم, with yāʾ as in لصاحبي and two identical triangle-on-baseline mīms. On 71r l.1 a divider follows فيها, then a separate three-sign رشا (“a fawn”). The next line begins تثنى: tāʾ, loop-footed upright, nūn and yāʾ. The four signs of تخجل follow an ordinary word separator; the vertical just before nūn in الغصون accompanies the preceding triangle-on-baseline. The upper hook of the first qāf in قلت differs in ink flow from the two rounded peaks in the later qāfs.
fit_against_record_wording: 62 signs in 16 groups. The verse includes لا تبع خيامهم فتقتل / فيها رشا اذا تثنى, resolving the record’s doubtful حبا مهم and فهارشا.
